cost: row O(cells), lbits O(cells), total_bits four cell scans. median O(B log B) time/O(B) owned buffer. Reporting loops corpora×layers×classes and sorts cell tables; orchestration costs pipeline jobs plus retained rows and serialized output bytes.
description: run_blocks chunks 512 references, executes shape transform/pipeline with par_each, converts errors to red Tally, and merges in order. row projects exact and damaged with equality to one. Numeric/report helpers aggregate residual cells, exclude Meta from totals and use upper median. main installs optional globals, parses flags, creates output, loads corpora then model, runs plans and writes reports sequentially.

inverse: Meta does not contribute total_bits, per(x,0) is zero, row exact_ok=2 is false. Errors from jobs cannot count as exact successes. Outputs are not transactional: later write failure can leave earlier files.

Rows erase Tally examples, most counters and provenance; compatible tallies share projected fields and exact/damaged predicates. Rounded tables admit intervals of f64 values and cannot uniquely recover cells. Earlier files alone do not establish successful final report.
